title: JobStatusResponse
description: The status and result of an asynchronous PDF operation job.

status.description: The current status of the job.

asset.description: The output asset information, available when status is done.

assetID.description: The asset ID of the output file.

downloadUri.description: The pre-signed download URI for the output file.

type.description: The MIME type of the output file.

size.description: The size of the output file in bytes.

error.description: Error information, available when status is failed.

status.description: The HTTP status code associated with the error.
